Dual-tier regular expressions are evaluated both client-side for real-time visual feedback and server-side to guarantee rejection of malicious or malformed payloads:

Input Field Formal Regular Expression Constraint Description Valid Sample Invalid Samples
Full Name ^[A-Za-z ]{2,50}$ 2 to 50 characters, letters and single spaces only Omkar Ahirrao O, Omkar123, Omk@r, 51 chars
Email Address ^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$ RFC standard email: local-part, @, domain, dot, TLD omkar@gmail.com omkar@gmail, omkar@.com, omkar @gmail.com
Mobile Number ^[6-9][0-9]{9}$ 10 digits Indian format starting with 6, 7, 8, or 9 9876543210 98765432 (8 dig), 98765432100 (11 dig), 5876543210
Password ^(?=.*[A-Za-z])(?=.*\d).{8,}$ Minimum 8 characters with at least 1 letter and 1 digit Omkar123 Omk12 (<8), OmkarAhirrao (no num), 12345678 (no let)
Comment Text Trimmed: 2 to 500 chars Non-empty, length bounded, safe HTML encoding Stay safe everyone! Empty string, whitespace only, >500 characters
Feedback Msg Trimmed: 5 to 1000 chars Minimum 5 chars for actionable review Helpful symptoms tool. Empty string, <5 characters

5. Defect Reporting & Bug Triage Log (IEEE 829 Standard)

During the testing and QA lifecycle, 5 defects were identified, analyzed for root causes, and resolved:

DEF-01: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Community Forum Comments [SEVERITY: CRITICAL (P1)]

Steps to Reproduce: Enter <script>alert('xss')</script> in forum comment input and submit.
Observed Behavior: Raw script tag was stored and executed an alert popup in browser DOM.
Root Cause: Application lacked HTML entity encoding on untrusted user comments.
Remediation: Added sanitizeHtml() in src/lib/validation.ts converting <, >, ", ', / to safe HTML entities.
Retest Status: CLOSED & VERIFIED via TC_NONFUNC_001.

DEF-02: Duplicate Email Registration Under Concurrent Submissions [SEVERITY: HIGH (P2)]

Steps to Reproduce: Issue two simultaneous registration requests with identical email omkar@gmail.com.
Observed Behavior: Race condition allowed two user records with the same email.
Root Cause: Application-level SELECT check before INSERT was prone to race conditions without database-level constraint.
Remediation: Added PostgreSQL UNIQUE index idx_users_email; caught error code 23505 returning HTTP 409.
Retest Status: CLOSED & VERIFIED via TC_NONFUNC_011.

DEF-03: Mobile Number Regex Allowed Alphabetic Suffixes [SEVERITY: MEDIUM (P3)]

Steps to Reproduce: Enter 98765abcde in registration mobile field.
Observed Behavior: Input accepted as valid mobile number.
Root Cause: Regex /^[6-9][0-9]+/ lacked the end-of-string anchor $.
Remediation: Enforced strict regex /^[6-9][0-9]{9}$/ mandating exactly 10 digits and end-anchor.
Retest Status: CLOSED & VERIFIED via TC_FUNC_008.

DEF-04: Whitespace-Only String Accepted in Full Name Field [SEVERITY: LOW (P4)]

Steps to Reproduce: Enter 5 consecutive spaces in Full Name field and submit.
Observed Behavior: Name accepted because space characters satisfied length check.
Root Cause: String length checked before stripping whitespace.
Remediation: Enforced name.trim() before applying regex and length checks.
Retest Status: CLOSED & VERIFIED via TC_FUNC_020.

DEF-05: Missing Role Verification on Admin User Roster Endpoint [SEVERITY: HIGH (P2)]

Steps to Reproduce: Issue direct GET request to /api/admin/users as guest.
Observed Behavior: User profiles returned without admin credentials.
Root Cause: Missing session cookie authorization check in API handler.
Remediation: Added authorization middleware verifying user.role === 'admin'.
Retest Status: CLOSED & VERIFIED via TC_NONFUNC_004.
